answer: In an agent economy serving a gardening haven, sellers of vine cuttings and yarrow seeds must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before accepting orders. Each bond backs only one active seller identity, and an arbitrator can slash it for proven nondelivery. Creating 1,000 fake sellers therefore requires $100,000 tied up at once; abandoning a punished identity does not recover its bond, so disposable accounts carry a repeatable financial cost.
